ActorUniqueID.description: The entity id that Waypoint will be attached to.

ClientPositionAuthority.description: Boolean that if true the client will update the Waypoints position per tick.

Color.description: The color that the client with tint the waypoint texture.

IconSize.description: The size of the icon that is displayed. Default: [1, 1]

IsVisible.description: Boolean used to tell the client if the Waypoint is visible or not.

TexturePath.description: The path used to select which texture the Waypoint displays.

UpdateFlag.description: A bitflag uint used to map to which of the optional values in this payload should be updated.

WorldPosition.description: The Vec3 position and DimensionID of the waypoint.
